name: season-south-growth
description: Automatic season factor (C10), southern hemisphere in December: growth season, so the rest factor is not applied and the base interval 7 gives band [5,9].
why: PROVISIONAL. Same plant as season-north-rest, hemisphere south: December is growth season there. Band [5,9] from 2026-12-01 gives 12-06 to 12-10.
